/ 400

Your study studio, explained.

Yeh aapki dono uploaded files par bana hua 400-question practice tool hai. Question English mein aur explanation Roman Hindi/Hinglish mein hi rakha hai. Yeh official NTA mock ya confirmed 2027 exam-pattern simulator nahi hai.

How it works

  • A–D ya option button se answer choose karein. Pehla selection lock hota hai; galat selection red aur valid answer green dikhta hai.
  • Previous/Next, question palette, ya neeche number type karke jump karein. Keyboard: ← / → navigation, A / B / C / D answer, M mark for review.
  • Practice score: correct +4, incorrect −1, unanswered 0. Total 400 questions ka set 720-mark full NEET paper nahi hai. 700+ result ki guarantee nahi di ja sakti.
  • Q35, Q50, Q65, Q225, Q329, Q360 aur Q392 mein source issues hain; yeh 7 questions score se excluded hain. Inhe learning ke liye rakha hai, forced wrong marking nahi hoti.
  • Visuals original, labelled educational illustrations hain—not photographs or exact textbook figures. Same underlying concept ke liye same scientific structure reuse ho sakta hai; irrelevant stock diagram har question mein nahi lagaya gaya hai. Match questions mein exact correct mapping ka visual map hai.
  • Explicitly described figures ke liye question ke neeche reconstruction diya hai. Answer-revealing labels sirf solution mein milte hain. Supplied text se missing original image ki exact appearance recover nahi ho sakti.

Source fidelity & cautions

Question 45 ki explicit draft correction apply ki gayi hai. Original explanation ki wording preserve ki gayi hai—even where a separate warning disagrees with it. Source key follow karna full scientific verification ke barabar nahi hai; har one of the 400 keys ka independent textbook audit claim nahi kiya gaya hai. Question 18 ka cucumber example aur Question 329 ki key separately corrected hain. Source mein purane exam years ya score claims hon to woh original text ka hissa hain, current exam guidance nahi.

Visual reference: NCERT Class XI Biology, Morphology of Flowering Plants. Seed-family caveat references: Malvaceae overview; Asteraceae seed morphology; Smithsonian Asteraceae description (stamen attachment). References checked 30 October 2026; external links need internet, the practice app does not.

Offline & saving

Download karke HTML ko browser mein kholein. Internet, CDN, font download ya separate images nahi chahiye. Browser agar local storage block kare, practice chalegi par refresh ke baad progress lost ho sakti hai. File move/browser change karne se saved progress accessible na ho—backup export use karein.
